column1: # host/i18n/files_launch.tsv: host texts of the launch and open paths of files/actions.rs.
# Columns: key<TAB>nl<TAB>en, exactly one tab each, UTF-8, LF. Escapes: \n \t \\ only. Placeholders {name}
# (ASCII letters, digits, _). Plurals: key.one / key.other (optional key.zero); one when the count is exactly 1.
# The first key segment is the file stem. nl is G's own 3b898e6 literal byte for byte (never H's); en is en-GB in
# Windows 11 wording (tools/i18n/glossary.tsv), taken from H only when H's nl is byte-identical.
# Rows are written by tools/i18n/extract_rs.py, never by hand. Lines starting with # are comments; translator
# context goes directly above its row. "#@ <path> <ordinal> <sha256[:16]> <fmt|plain|en|enfmt> [<spec>=<name> ...]"
# and "#@ new" lines are machine records of the 3b898e6 literal a row replaced (en/enfmt: the English half of a
# former inline pair) or of new Dutch text; tools/i18n/drift_rust.py checks them.
# Checked by: python3 -B tools/i18n/check_rust.py and python3 -B tools/i18n/drift_rust.py (notes/claude/round2-gate.md).
